tokens.name: bg-window
tokens.usage: Ivory ground: window, sidebar, onboarding steps. Source: board / logo cream.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Raised paper: Hub content panel, cards, fields, menus, paper toasts. Source: board.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Sunken fill: feature card, style samples, onboarding illustration wells, info cards. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered list row. Source: board (dark derived).

tokens.name: fill-selected
tokens.usage: Selected sidebar row, segmented-control track, small icon-button fill. Source: board.

tokens.name: fill-chip
tokens.usage: Stat strip on Home. Source: board.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Ink: titles, labels, body, icons. 14.5:1 on ivory, 15.6:1 on raised; dark 14.5:1.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions and paragraphs under titles. 6.0:1 ivory, 6.4:1 raised, 5.4:1 sunken; dark 6.3:1 ink, 5.4:1 raised.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Captions, mono meta, timestamps, hints. Replaces the boards' stone text (3.2:1). 4.7:1 ivory, 5.0:1 raised; on bg-sunken or fill-selected use text-secondary. Dark 5.6:1 / 4.8:1.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Decorative only: swatches, off-toggle knob, idle marks. Never text (3.2:1 on ivory). Source: board.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Cards, list containers, window edge. Decorative separation; never the only cue for a control. Source: board.

tokens.name: border-divider
tokens.usage: Rows inside lists and settings groups. Source: board.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Field outlines, empty radios, off toggles, select buttons: anything whose edge identifies a control. 3.2:1 ivory, 3.4:1 raised; dark 4.9:1 / 4.2:1. Darker than the boards' 18-35% ink rings, which measured 1.4-2.1:1.

tokens.name: accent-clay
tokens.usage: The single accent: one primary action per screen, the live mic, the brand mark. Never highlights menus, never marks errors. Source: logo.

tokens.name: accent-clay-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed (light darkens 6% L, dark lightens 6% L). Derived.

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent-clay. Light 4.5:1 (at the AA floor: keep 14pt medium or larger); dark 5.1:1.

tokens.name: ink-fill
tokens.usage: Solid secondary buttons (Add word, Save), toggle on, selected-card ring, filled radio, menu highlight. Source: board.

tokens.name: ink-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: ink-fill pressed. Derived.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and knobs on ink-fill. 14.5:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2pt keyboard focus ring with a 2pt gap. Source: board.

tokens.name: flow-fill
tokens.usage: Flow Bar pill, Flow Bar toasts and alerts. Follows system appearance: ink in light, raised ink in dark. Source: board.

tokens.name: flow-ring
tokens.usage: 1pt inset edge on every Flow Bar surface, so it separates from dark windows. Source: board.

tokens.name: flow-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the Flow Bar. 14.5:1.

tokens.name: flow-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Sub-lines and word counts on the Flow Bar. 5.3:1.

tokens.name: flow-idle-mark
tokens.usage: The 20 x 1.5pt dash in the idle pill. 4.0:1.

tokens.name: flow-live
tokens.usage: Live waveform, live dot, stop button: clay lifted for ink. 5.1:1 on ink.

tokens.name: flow-stop-glyph
tokens.usage: 8pt rounded square inside the stop button. 5.1:1 on flow-live.

tokens.name: flow-cancel
tokens.usage: Cancel (X) circle in hands-free. The ivory X on it is 11.2:1.

tokens.name: flow-button
tokens.usage: Primary button inside a Flow Bar toast (Undo, Retry, Switch microphone), with flow-button-text.

tokens.name: flow-button-text
tokens.usage: Text on flow-button. 14.5:1.

tokens.name: flow-button-ring
tokens.usage: Secondary button inside a Flow Bar toast (Open History, Dismiss): 1pt inset ring, no fill.

families.serif: Newsreader, "Iowan Old Style", "New York", Georgia, serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Hub page titles; a name or one word may be italic.

styles.name: feature-title

styles.name: trigger
styles.usage: Spoken snippet triggers, always in curly quotes.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “um so I think we should uh, no wait, let's ship Friday”
styles.usage: Raw speech, sounds-like hints, practice lines.

styles.name: sample
styles.usage: Finished-writing samples on style, cleanup and feature cards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick a style for messages, work chats and email.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Settings row labels, menu items, Flow Bar text.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: Hold to speak, release to type.

styles.name: flow-sub
styles.usage: Second line inside Flow Bar toasts. Minimum size anywhere.
